reviews.review_description: Essential Solar are great to deal with. Very quick to come out and quote, installation crew were on time and organized. We got help and support from their office team with the rebates and follow-up. I would highly recommend them and have already passed their information on to family and friends.

In late 2023 I was looking for an Australian owned Solar installation company with a shop front and a track record it took a while to find a company with my requirements I finally found EssentialSolar in Tullamarine Melbourne 3043, they gave me a completive quote for 6.6kw Solar PV system with 15x Ja 440 Double glass panels and Goodwe GW5000-DNS-30 Inverter installed in December the Installation went well with no problems it has been working great.In 2025 the govt said they would be giving Solar Battery rebates, so I enquired about them at EssentialSolar they gave me a quote for a Goodwe GW5000N-EH Plus Hybrid Inverter and a Goodwe LynxLX F19.2H-20 Battery classed as a 20KW Battery  the company installed the battery and inverter on the 1st July 2025  with their experience the installation went without a problem we have now had the battery for nearly 20 weeks it has worked great on average we use app 30-35% a night sometimes higher our electricity bills are 0.After the installation they organised the grid connection and showed us how it operated, the Goodwe app on mobile phone and ipad works well.EssentialSolar is an Australian family owned company started in 2012 13years ago they have an honorable track record in the Solar industry anyone looking for a Solar company I would recommend them as experience and knowledge in the Solar industry their  employes are tops.

Essential Solar have been excellent to work through our Solar System needs.From the initial Technical Sales meeting through to installation it’s been a very smooth process.This has all been backed up by the internal Customer Service representative.I would have no hesitation in recommending Essential Solar.
Sales and quoting process was top notch, no pressure and adjusted our plan based on our budget. Install team came when planned and cleaned up when finished. Easy to contact office as required.

6 x men arrived on time to install a 4.4 Kw solar system on a 2 x story townhouse. They were all very friendly, courteous and polite. Installing an A-Grade system with A-Grade electricians. It only took about 4 hours to complete and they left the site neat and tidy afterwards. I would highly recommend Essential Solar. It's been hassle free from beginning to end.

Essential Solar earns a perfect 10 out of 10 from me for outstanding customer service, streamlined processes from start to finish, and safe, high-quality workmanship throughout an impressively efficient solar system installation.My research:I was new to the current Government rebate program, which was a HUGE motivation to consider going solar and optimising my investment. So over 3-4 weeks I viewed SO MANY of the adverts, videos, recommendations out there, and asked heaps of questions to experts, friends and family who had actual experience. Being careful is so important, there are risks, even scams out there!  (The SolarQuotes website was very helpful to me)My conclusions & plan:1. CHOOSE tested, proven and recommended products2. CHOOSE a recommended installer with a 1st class record3. DO your homework in selecting product size and configuration4. QUOTES are very helpful, ensure comparing apples with apples5. KEEP RECORDS documents and photos, of the whole processMy Experience with Essential Solar:Every contact was professional and respectful. It started with the Salesman’s visit focussing on my specific needs, then my allocated customer service contact whose prompt responses to my many questions gave me great confidence and showed flexibility as well. Input from technical experts during design was impressive, and finally a safe, qualified and efficient installation team of 5 were fully organised and did a great job in 5 hours! Even the General Manager took time to speak with me to achieve the very fair price at the start. (Essential Solar are a highly recommended installer by SolarQuotes)Project timing:The Essential Solar salesman said installation would be in 2-3 weeks, and it was! As expected, the electrical inspector came 10 days later to check and commission it, and now it is all working amazingly, no glitches and free power!The products:I selected 21 x JA Solar Bifacial PANELS and a TESLA Powerwall 3 BATTERY.  I chose to back up only the power and lighting circuits, and the battery is installed outdoors, as it's rated for external use, and positioned in a shaded and sheltered location for added protection.Final comment:I absolutely recommend Essential Solar to do an awesome solar project… again 10 out of 10.PS: Making this big decision with confidence right from the start felt great, and now that the project’s done, it’s even more satisfying to know it was the right call.

Essential Solar was fantastic to deal with, from the initial call to installation and final documentation.  They were efficient and responsive to any questions.  The installation was done in time and the site was clean and tidy after installation.   The Solar and Battery installation was completed within 3 weeks of quote acceptance. Every interaction with this company was a pleasure.   Thank you !

The quoting process was excellent. The designer visited our home and we were able to discuss all aspects of the design.  Any calls to the company were answered promptly and all communication was clear and detailed.  The installation process was very slow. The installers were polite and friendly but did not communicate their attendance far in advance. After removing our old solar panels they did not return for some days, leaving the new panels stacked in the garden for more than a week. The entire process took thirteen days.

System and installation ,top quality work.$28000 system with battery.This is not my first solar and battery system.Then came the disappointment.Power failureNo battery backupCalled Essential Solar, sorry you did not pay for that additional system it’s in your contract.Well it’s also in their flashy advertising material in big letters:No gridLife goes onThey tell me it’s a huge misconception that a battery gives you backup.This is what is expected from a solar/battery in my and I’m sure any persons opinion:Helps save the planetSaves you moneySmile when there is a power failureI now feel scammed, disappointed, embarrassed and foolish for trusting a company.Do we all read our apple terms and conditions, no, we expect what’s normal not a up selling system.

Essential Solar need to be commended on the professionalism and efficiency with which they handled my solar installation.Their price was competitive, and Sam also reviewed the system and made a generous contribution, through no pressure from my end. Purely because he saw that an extra panel was needed to make the most out of the installation.It took 2 weeks from quote acceptance to being able to turn on the system, which is pretty fantastic, considering the amount of paperwork and coordination that no doubt needs to be done in between.They were understanding of my needs and requirements, and listened to my questions, and answered them honestly. I had some queries about placing some panels on the opposite facing roof, and they were willing at every point to discuss this and come back with reviews based on my query. And their installer was extremely courteous and professional in my dealings with him on the day. This was alongside a previous smaller solar installation that has been sitting on the roof for a while now.To top it all off, they are a local company, which has left me with more than a touch of feel good about doing my part. Keep up the great work team
The quote was direct and clear. The installation was punctual and prompt. They took time to answer our questions.

I recently had a solar panel and battery system installed in an outer Melbourne suburb. The whole process from initial inquiry, to paperwork, to government rebates request, to the day of installation all went extremely smoothly, with no problems at all.My system has been up and running for a few weeks now, and seems to be working perfectly.I would recommend Essential Solar without any hesitation.
Great Installer. Really helped me by moving installation earlier than originally organised. Use with confidence!

Some companies quote over the phone for solar installation, without even visiting your property. Some don't even look at your energy usage pattern. Euan from Essential Solar visited our home and was very thorough in working out the best system for our home. The installation process was straight forward and the installers were polite and tidy. They listened to our request to leave some distance between the upper windows and the solar panels as we knew we needed to replace the windows in the future. Essential Solar provided an app to monitor solar generation and energy usage. They also helped us with the solar rebate. The system installed is battery ready and we hope to install a battery in future.

I am extremely impressed with the professionalism of Essential Solar. The installation was very impressive and I was informed every step of the way until completion. A very happy experience for me. I pay monthly making it affordable while saving on my electricity bill.

Installation was a smooth operation.  Essential Solar representatives were always available to assist with any enquiry.  Price was competitive to other small companies while providing a large company backup.

A great company to deal with no problems at all they put our install back 1 day which we were informed beforehand and kept in the loop  which some trades out there don’t even call you would not hesitate to recommend this company to anyone a great job

From start to finish, I was extremely satisfied with Essential Solar. Their team was friendly, knowledgeable, and professional throughout the entire process. They not only matched the price but also invested more time and effort during the initial quote compared to other companies. I highly recommend their services.

Essential Solar recently installed an additional solar system for us. Very impressed with their knowledge, professionalism, the install and customer service. Post install they helped resolve an issue with the supplier on my behalf. Highly recommended.

The guys from Essential Solar did a great job on my recent HWHP install. Very efficient, cleaned up after themselves well and very clean, neat install. Hats off to Nick and the the plumber (whose name I forget!)They also installed my mew Induction Cooktop so it was a one stop shop for both jobs which made life a lot easier.Thanks guys!Good price and great service from all the guys at Essential Solar.

The sales/quoting process:I found them to be very accommodating to what we wanted and were very willing to make adjustments. However the design ended up a little different upon installation because they realised they couldn't fit as many panels on the roof spaces we had, this is despite having already sent a person to measure the roof after we had paid the deposit.  So 4 stars for that whole process.The install:The whole system with 36 panels with optimisers, a battery and an EV charger started at 7am and finished by 4pm. The team cleaned up after themselves mostly so that was good. However, our oven was somehow left without any power despite the switch in the switchboard being in the ON position, so they had disconnected it somehow during the work and didn't reconnect it.  We didn't discover this for a few days because we didn't need the oven and everything else in the house was fine.4 stars for this. At the time of writing, 11 days after the install, they still haven't come back to reconnect the oven and I'm still messaging them.The invoicing/after sales service:The invoice wasn't itemised.  So there was a lump sum for everything that was installed minus rebates and STC's and government loans.  This became a problem because when they had to adjust the invoice down from the original 39 panels system to now 36 panels, I couldn't understand why the amount hadn't reduced at all. They said the reduction was $375 for 3 less panels but I also had less STC's and somehow I'm still paying the exact same amount as before. That doesn't sound right to me so I'm still trying to get them to send me something that makes sense before paying.  Apparently all providers insist on full payments before or on the day of installation, which isn't great for the homeowner.  They should accept 90% payment and receive the remainder 10% after the system has passed inspection. This would be a fairer payment structure for everyone to ensure their work is performed well.

Solar is an interesting journey, we all get a million calls trying to sell it to us, and marketed to by a thousand companies, which makes it really off-putting when you decide to take the plunge.These guys are the real deal, Its actually a business that exists, has a premise, has its own staff etc all the things you want when purchasing this type of product. Additionally when installing on terracotta roof tiles who ever installs can do more damage then its worth especially when the tiles where fresh out of the kiln and still brittle.These fellas did the trick, didnt damage anything, the install was clean and the attention to detail was spot on. In this case the install was done on my new house that is being built by my father who has 35 year experience as a builder, so we were well onto the installers every step of the way, and there was nothing to fault at all.Dont much around with random companies on the net just go with essential. Big thanks to Nick who did my install, he is a true gentleman and old school skilled tradesman.

We got four quotes from different suppliers and ended up going with Essential Solar, due in no small part to sales rep Harry. They were also able to squeeze one more panel in compared with the other offers, which was an added bonus.The installation was quick - they not only got everything up in a few hours, they also removed a couple of old solar panels used for hot water (installed when the house was built in 2009). The guys appeared to have a great time up on the roof, cleared away all the odds and ends, and everyone was super polite.There was a minor snag with the certification process, but after a few attempts the system was turned on. We're still waiting for our electricity provider to upgrade our meter box (or whatever it is they do), but that's another matter and not the reason we wanted solar panels in the first place.We opted against a battery at this time, purely because of the cost.

Once we got through all the government red tape and paper work (which was a nightmare for the elderly coz everything is online) installation went ahead fine.Only negative would be we needed some explaining on how the system works and when the back up for the battery works. It seemed just to get installed and then we were on our own.Received a user manual by email 3 months later.Ed at customer service was brilliant and very polite and helpful.

Really poor customer service we have had to chase/call them for any information. Managed to blame every body else for delays in supplying a certificate of safety 1 month after install and still waiting for it. This has been an absolute disasterWe do not recommend.

From quote through to sign off, the process was professional. At each step the team answered any questions we had and we found them to be honest and transparent. It was a big investment, but value for money. The experience was easy and we were happy with the final outcomes.

We had our solar system installed on our townhouse a few months ago, and the experience was fantastic from start to finish.The sales and quoting process was smooth and professional. Thanks to Euan. He arrived on time, took the time to answer all our questions, measured up, and provided recommendations on where to install the inverter, even giving us a few options.The installation went just as smoothly. The team was punctual, polite, and worked tidily throughout the process. They left everything neat and in order, which was much appreciated.Their customer service was excellent, providing end-to-end assistance. Ed and Jessica made the process easy by organising the grid connection after installation and ensuring we knew how everything worked.We honestly cannot fault any part of the experience – great service, communication, and support all the way through. We highly recommend this Essential Solar if you are considering solar!
Very professional sales and consultation process. Great install.Very happy with the results.
The Essential Solar team was very professional, they didn't just answer my questions but also provided insights and recommendation about solar panels. He was also very patient with my enquiries.

Excellent installation of a 9.5kw fronius system. The initial quote and site visit was excellent with options provided along with reasoned recommendations and a can do attitude. Booking the installation was easy and a date booked in within a week of approving the quote. There was a small change to the system specs during installation but this was all communicated well in the day and the quote adjusted appropriately. Follow up emails and getting online were all simple and everything has just worked perfectly from the start. Highly recommend!

From the start of the quotation process to the final paperwork and sign off of the installed system, everything was done cleanly and smoothly by this company.  I modified my requirements a couple times which were easily integrated into the design.  Wait time for the install was less than 2 weeks from when I agreed to the design and the installation subcontractors engaged carried out the install in a single day (as expected).  The independent safety inspector even commented on how good a job the installers did.  Thanks Essential Solar, another happy customer.

Had an overall very positive experience with Essential Solar. The consultant did the site inspection and made recommendations based on actual conditions on-site which is assuring. I wished he was a bit more proactive, but not a deal breaker.After that, the installation, the inspection and payment process was really smooth. I also overpaid the project by accident which I overlooked but the customer service person was great in bringing that to my attention and organised a refund to my account with no delays. The system is working very well now and am happy with the overall quality.

All aspects of quoting, inspection and installation proceeded in an orderly and informative manner. Polite, tidy and punctual despite the rainy day. They were helpful despite my lack of technical and internet proficiency.

The individual who came for the sales/quoting process was knowledgeable. We ended up with a larger system than we probably need but it leaves scope for a battery and/or EV once they become worthwhile. Installers were punctual, polite and efficient. We've only had the system for three months but quality seems to be good. We are certainly generating more power than expected. Definitely recommend you include them in the companies from which you obtain quotes.

After getting 3 quotes Essential Solar's representative stood out as the most informative and helpful of the 3.Customer Support made the whole process very easy in assisting with organising paperwork, installation etc.The two man team who installed the system were very friendly and efficient.Had to restart the Inverter once and was walked through the process by Customer Support Team.

The supplier was good, explained all the requirements for the system and gave options for various panels and inverters and explained the pros & cons of each of the options. The installers came on time discussed final placement of the inverter and cables prior to installation and installed the inverter where requested. The supplier followed up with the grid connection and submitted all paperwork to our electricity supplier the day of install so it could be certified ASAP.Overall it was a fairly easy experience from quotes, through to final connection.

The sales process was very smooth and well sorted out. Organising the installation date was tricky because rain was forecast on the planned installation date but Essential Solar were very good in sorting out a date that would suit. The installing electrician (Stuart) was excellent. He did a high quality job even though he had a few issues to sort out. The biggest problem he had was in removing my old slar panels. He had to find a special pentagonal socket spanner which was very hard to get. There was a resulting delay but Stuart was very good at working with us to find time to get the job done.Stuart was very good in his communications and I felt that he was paying attention to quality so I am confident that we will have maany years of trouble free use.His hand over of the system was well done and he was clear about how it worked, where the fuses were, what the various swiches did, how to use the iSolarCloud app and how the components were connected.

Sales and quoting process was fine and the work was great and they were very tidy and hardworking. In terms of improvements to the experience, it would have been better if the use of subcontracted installation services was disclosed during the quoting process as it would have resulted in me undertaking more due diligence. I think this and the process from acceptance of the quote could also have been better explained to manage our expectations. Other than these points we are very happy with the job noting the system is operating, but not yet connected to the grid. We are not able to comment on performance given it is the middle of winter.

The quoting inspection revealed an upgrade of switchboard was necessary. They were happy to give me quotes for many different scenarios and different equipment.The installation was the very next week, which went smoothly and the inspector hooked it up the following week, all very efficient.
No complaints. Very happy with the whole process. I have recommended them to my sister who is going to contact them.

Informative sales person - visited the property - responded promptly to requested changes in quoting.Very professional installation. Slight confusion over backup circuits but was rectified immediately and agreeably.I was shown briefly how to operate and inspection and connection proceeded as planned.

Using the Finn Peacock Solarquotes process made the whole experience straight forward.The three quotes were varied in their offering giving us good comparisons of our options.Helpful spreadsheets etc made comparisons easy.All respondents were responsive, professional, courteous and on-time for visits.Whilst were happy to choose any of the three we were swayed by Ray Bout's (Essential) knowledge, approach and cost competitiveness of the solution.

Solar quotes provided a quote from a company Essential Solar. Sales rep Ray provided a thorough quote and understanding of what to expect. Installation team were very good with a lot of information for us. Federal rebate arrangement by Essential Solar and  Vic state rebate process very easy to do. Fast approval and installation went off with out hassle
Essential solar were great in terms of sales and after sales. Highly recommend them. Thanks to sales person Natalie Hummel and Jessica Kidd. Also, Amir was a great installer.
From the quote to grid connection was about 3 weeks everything was organised for me very impressive team

From the first enquiry with Essential Solar to the completion of the installation of a 6 Kw solar system we experienced a professionalism beyond our expectations. The on site visit from the Technical Sales Adviser set the tone and gave us confidence to proceed. Communication between all those involved with the process was seamless.  A detailed, precise and accurate outline of all the regulatory steps to be followed was very helpful.  The quality of the work of the installers was commented on during the electrical safety inspection. Essential solar handled negotiations with our energy provider, connections to the grid etc. Upon completion we received a comprehensive documentation file. We highly recommend Essential Solar.

The sales/quoting process was very professional and informative. Any questions were answered fully and promptly.  Staff from Essential Solar remained in contact with us throughout the quoting, application and installation processes, and each step happened quite quickly. The installers were punctual, friendly and professional.  As the system was installed only a couple of days ago it has not been certified yet, but this should hopefully happen in the next week or so.

Essential Solar gave clear and informed advice on the solar installation options - I felt well informed of key concepts for consideration.They have locally based staff who have long tenure with the company and industry which gave me confidence.The installation team did attempt to add additional charges associated with upgrading the switchboard which were not communicated at the time. I pushed back on this and Essential Solar accepted this as their cost.The post sale support was well communicated and timely - they were clear on the multiple steps in the process and stuck to the plan they communicated.Happy to recommend Essential Solar

Solar quotes was the starting point to get solar installed. They provided 2 companies to quote. One company was not interested but essential solar were very informative and professional. Sales  rep had done his homework and had a comprehensive contract. Installation team delivered the panels a few days before and took the time to scope the job. Installation guys were 100% to deal with and set up our phone apps etc. Very highly recommend this company

Paul was very friendly and helpful with no "hard sell".  I have never had a solar system before and was provided with a full explanation of which system would work best for me and the installation process. The communication regarding the installation (they always turned up on time) was great and the office staff were always friendly and helpful and answered all of my questions.  Because my house was a new build there was a hiccup with the location of the switchboard. I would encourage all new build owners to provide their solar company with a set of plans showing the location of their services or to wait until their house is completely finished with all services installed to ensure there are no encroachments to the location of the switchboard.  After some (at times stressful) negotiations about moving the switchboard the issue was fixed and I was shown how to download the app.  The process of obtaining the rebate was made easy for me and they also organised everything with my connection to the grid so I could get my feed in tarriffs after the final install.  I am very happy with the Enphase app that lets me monitor input/output and choose the best times to use my solar energy.

Quick to give quote and get process running. Consultants were polite and efficient, helpful in addressing issues and concerns. Punctual and tidy on day of install. Gave quotes on different brands all rated highly. Very competitive pricing. Willing to install system where other installers said it was not possible or worth it.
Excellent technical sales service that explained all the necessary concepts clearly and succinctly.Local in house installation crew and attentive and responsive customer service team

The whole process was generally very clear and professional. The only negative was that they wouldn't itemise the quote, which meant I had to manually calculate each item based on other data to do a quote comparison, which seemed unnecessarily opaque.The planning, installation and connection all went well, with clear communication throughout.Pleased with the service by the whole team.

From the start to the finish everything and everyone were brilliant,The only downside was that someone had to miss out on a job,If I could have used 2 installers I would have been happy to do so.I spent most of my live in customer service so I’m very critical when it comes to service , everything was 5 starThank you solar quotes for the fantastic leads

Agreed to scheduled installation date which was completed in one dayAlso the electrical installers managed to organise for Electrical Inspector to approve installation on the same day.pricing was competitive so choice of supplier was more about quality of product and delivery of service.No problem promoting them as a preferred supplier
Excellent sales/quoting process. The installation was prompt and professional and overall customer service communication was excellent from initial enquiry, through to installation.

From the first phone call. All the staff including installation staff were very helpful.  Would recommend. Explained everything very clearly and answered all my questions.  Good quality and good value

Had a great experience with Essential and very happy with the result. Our bills by default seem to be reduced by around 33% on average (only one big summer month to compare with), more if we did more during the day to maximise usage of what we produce (didn't get a battery).Quote stage was long (our doing), but good. Of the three recommended to me by SolarQuotes, Essential was the only one that arranged a time to actually look at what they were dealing with and be a matter of fact, practical and professional with their assessment of our needs and wants. After a bit of back and forth (me to get the best price and best inclusions, we weren't looking for cheap, we were looking for quality with the aim in future proofing), we proceeded with Essential Solar due to their care and attention to detail and the selling point for me was using their own employees and nothing was contracted out. Our price included brackets and clips for a flat Kliplok roof, a new meterbox installation, rewiring of the old one, and a consumption monitor (best thing we purchased!!).Once deposit was paid, they were very swift in setting up installations. Installers were on time on a very hot day and got straight to it, installing with care all the panels (photo attached) and doing a good job of it! They couldn't do everything in the one full day, so they came back 1.5 weeks later to finish it: they did the conduit cables, all the wiring and installed/set up the inverter in a three-quarter day.Once installation was completed, the electrician's instructions were clear and explained everything to me and even gave me advice on what to do in the future when we consider EV (reason we added the new box) and battery installations. Above and beyond. Effortless, friendly and professional. Only one criticism I have in relation to the conduit installation was a failed drill hole in the render at the front door, a bit visible. But small. I cannot speak for the roof and whether any damage is up there (I have no way to get on the roof, it's quite high and no ladder), but from the photos it looks pretty sound with care clearly taken to not create any issues.Process following this was quick as well. They arranged the inspector to sign off quickly was all done within 2 days. Sadly the slowest (and most unfortunate point) was on the retailer and electricity provider: they charged us extra to configure the main meter remotely to accept FiT metred to the grid and took a little longer than I would have liked (5 business days, max was 20). Essential did make it clear to us that this may happen from the very beginning, so all our expectations were met and there were no surprises.We've had it for a good two to three weeks now, metred with the retailer for about one and am very impressed with the overall experience Essential has provided to us. As it's all still new to us I go back to them every week or so with questions that pop up and they respond within a timely manner and have been incredibly professional throughout. I am very glad we proceeded with Essential and I look forward to coming back to them in future for maintenance and when we save enough to invest in a battery.

Sales/quoting process was good, only one of the three quotes where someone came onsite before providing the quote.The installation ran well, punctual, polite, timely and tidy.Everything was organised.

The whole process was simple and quick. The installation was of good quality and the staff acted in a professional manner. Unfortunately I was unable to obtain a feed in tariff as AusNet do not allow any export to the grid
Responsive customer service and the (sub-contracted) installation team was great.

I would recommend Essential Solar as a great installer. Communication with customers seems like is on the top level. Also, I liked the quality of the installation. The one thing that could be better is communication between office employees and the installation crew. The reason for that: I often contacted the office and we discussed my skylights, which I want to keep, and which I don't need any longer. I specified that the panels could be installed over them. On the day of the installation though the manager of the installer crew told me that the skylights that I don't need should be removed in advance. Eventually, the crew kindly removed the unnecessary skylight themselves however it wasn't communicated to me by the office team.

The sales process was generally very good. Some photographs of the installation site didn't make their way to the system designer. Consequently the design had to be modified. But this happened smoothly with no resulting delay. Installation was quick and tidy. I observed and notified one minor issue at 4.30 pm a couple of days later. A person was on site fixing it at 7.45 the next morning. Incredible service. Essential solar looked after all the paperwork and organised grid connection including modification of my electrical meter. The system has performed well. I opted to have a "smart" meter installed. This is mounted in the switchboard and allows monitoring of what is happening (power generation and consumption) on my mobile phone. This has been useful in deciding when to run appliances, heating etc, to minimise power consumption from the grid during periods of low solar .panel output

Very well organised. Took the time to actually visit our premises. Quote came through quickly together with all the technical specs. Again were quick to put wheels in motion once quote was accepted, installed within 3 weeks and inspected day after. Great work all round.

After my initial enquiry they scheduled a timely appointment. The consultant explained the different options and we were able to make a decision at our meeting. The consultant was very courteous and knowledgeable. They undertook the work within the agreed timetable. The independent engineer who approved the work commented that Essential Solar had done a very good job.

I liked that Essential Solar did a thorough physical inspection of the roof before the installation date and as a consequence had to reduce the number of proposed panels. The installation team were prompt, friendly, professional and informative and tidied up upon completion. When an unexpected problem occurred they modified the layout so that the overall system size was unaffected. The system still is awaiting official inspection but that has been organised.

We are the very happy new owners of a 9kw solar system. We were delighted at every step - from sales to install to connection - by the people at Essential Solar with whom we interacted. Great team, very competitive pricing and incredibly patient with all our questions. Managing to squeeze in an install start before the end of the year was a big bonus. Can't recommend Essential highly enough.

I have a terrible roof layout for solar, 2 bedroom unit with all sorts of odd roof lines.Most installers I contacted promptly ignored me and the few that responded basically told me not to bother / it wasn't worth it.I'm stubborn and fortunately I lucked upon Essential Solar who were more than happy to put together a proposal for me. It was exactly what I wanted and the price was extremely reasonable given the circumstances I had put them under.System is x9 JA 440W solar panels + 9 IQ8AC Enphase microinverters on a variety of faces/orientations with consumption monitoring. 4 East (Roof), 2 North (Garage / Carport), 1 North (Roof), 2 West (Roof).The installers did an excellent job, didn't break a single tile on my roof (Concrete tiles) and didn't leave a single leak. Everyone I dealt with throughout the entire process made it extremely easy.Would definitely recommend.

Fact Finding very good with Hayley.The quoting process was good and Hayley worked hard to provide the system best suited to our home.The installation was good.We were delayed as a new swirchboard was required.Anthony did a great job with the install,very courteous,punctual and well organised.Customer service with Ed and Jessica were very helpful and quick to respond.
Essential Solar where professional in all aspects of the process from sales and quotes to customer service and installation I recommend the to anyone who is looking to install solar

My system has been installed now for about 4 weeks and things have been going well.  Essential Solar is a professional outfit and dealing with them was a refreshing experience. From sales to installation, to aftersales documentation, the team has it together.  I would definitely recommend.

Had my system installed by essential solar. The salesman was a nice bloke, the system he offered was a little more expensive then some of the other quotes. However he seemed to really know his stuff and I trusted he was offering me a good value system.The installation took most of the day, everything seemingly went well.The only criticism I would have is some of our garage epoxy and tiles out the backyard were damaged on installation day. Otherwise not a bad experience.Currently waiting for the paperwork to be processed in order to have the system connected to the grid.Early signs are that the system is producing well.

Had I known this would happen I would have asked for the panels to be arranged in 2 rows (further back), or for the isolator to be installed on the other side of the panels (the back of the roof).
